title: App Store preview
description: App Store and Google Play preview videos: up to three 15 to 30 second cuts per locale, each standalone (what it is, the best feature, the payoff). Covers the verified store specs (Apple's 886 x 1920 and 1200 x 1600 sizes, 30 fps cap, H.264 settings, the 5 second poster frame; Play's YouTube link rules), what each store rejects (hands, prices, dates, footage outside the app), muted-first design, native full-screen framing with touch hotspots, frame budgets, export and ffprobe checks. Load it when the ask is a store listing preview, not a general product video.
summary: Up to three standalone 15–30 s store previews per locale: verified sizes and encoding, muted-first, native UI, the poster frame.

requires.why: The real, current-build screen recordings the whole preview depends on.
Re-checking the stores' current preview specs before submission.
Encoding to the store's exact spec, adding a stereo track and probing the result.
An optional licensed track for sound-on viewers.
The frame-15, poster-frame and muted-review checks.

route.deliverable: Up to three 15–30 second App Store or Google Play preview videos built from the app's own screens, to the store's exact spec
askFirst: Which store, and which devices (iPhone, iPad)?
Do you have screen recordings of the current build?
Which languages does the listing need?
